design_philosophy.core_concept: Handmade with Love. Won with Luck.
design_philosophy.visual_style: Soft textures, organic shapes, warm neutrals, generous whitespace

typography.usage_rules: Use Playfair Display for all section titles and hero text. Use Nunito for product descriptions and UI elements. Use Caveat for 'handwritten' notes, prices, or 'Made by' tags.

primary.description: Sage Green - Calming, natural, represents the 'Handmade' aspect

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold shadow-soft transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-primary/20 text-primary hover:bg-primary/5 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium transition-all

cards.product: bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-border/40 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lifted transition-all duration-300 group

inputs.default: bg-white border-border/60 focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-lg h-12 px-4

layout_strategies.grid_system: Use a 'Masonry' or 'Bento' style grid for products. Avoid rigid uniform grids. Mix tall (crochet dolls) and wide (cards) items.
layout_strategies.spacing: Generous padding. Section spacing: py-20 or py-24. Element spacing: gap-6 or gap-8.

motion.micro_interactions: Active scale-95 on buttons. Subtle rotation on product hover.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Spin the Wheel' game using a library like 'react-roulette-pro' or custom SVG/Framer Motion. It must feel 'heavy' and 'real'.
Use the provided logo in the header. It has a festive/crochet theme, so ensure the header background complements it (likely white or very pale cream).
For the 'Story' section on product pages, use a layout that looks like a journal entry or a scrapbook page.
Ensure the 'My Rewards' wallet feels valuable—use gold/accent colors for the points/coupons.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons. Pick rounded, friendly icons.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
